# JSON callers provide lists; copy to a tuple so a frozen prediction
        # cannot be changed through an external mutable delay list.
        object.__setattr__(self, 'delays_days', tuple(float(x) for x in self.delays_days))
explanation: Only input delay-list copying to an immutable float tuple was added. Every executed initializer and optimizer decode already supplied a tuple; likelihood, optimizer, smoother and score functions are byte-identical. No numerical fit replay is required.
